summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and refactored the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers to delegate to them. Updated the NIfTI writer default dtype, renamed output_path to output_dir in the examples and integration test, and added or updated five test files. Nothing was run: no tests, flake8, or imports were executed, so all results are unverified. Nothing was committed. Changes are unstaged in the working tree.
